text:
samir_p: Heads-up — after the 1.0 launch we have a growing backlog of small stability bugs + a set of feature asks from two pilots. Need to decide triage lane: quick hotfixes vs queued enhancements. Proposal below.

maria_g: +1 on deciding quickly. Can you paste current counts/impact? I can pull the telemetry.

samir_p: Quick numbers: ~14 P1/P2 incidents in last 7 days (mostly streaming timeout + edge cache invalidation), ~22 feature asks (billing UI, analytics export, improved SDK retries). Top customer complaining is BoltMed (paying Dedicated customer).

ajay_k: Suggest a rule: anything causing customer-visible error or SLA breach => hotfix lane. Non-blocking UX polish or new surface area => enhancement backlog. Use `error_rate > 0.5%` or `p99_latency > 2s` on core API as cutoff, and customer tier override for Dedicated/enterprise.

product_lead: Agree with Ajay's rule. Also: two operational constraints — 1) we can run a 2-week hotfix lane (max 3 engineers) without blocking next sprint, 2) we need a groomed backlog for the March follow-on milestone. We should set explicit acceptance criteria for hotfixes: regression tests + canary for 24h before prod tag.

maria_g: I can run a quick eval set against the failing flows and flag which bugs regress customer signal. Will post the list by EOD.

samir_p: For prioritization matrix I'm proposing: Severity (S1-S3) x Customer tier (Enterprise/Startup) => lane. Example: S1+Enterprise => immediate hotfix with SLA w/ on-call rotation. S2+Enterprise or S1+Startup => fast-track for next hotfix batch. Rest go to grooming.

ajay_k: +thumbsup. Also add a cost column — estimated infra/cpu impact for fixes. Some fixes (e.g., caching TTL tuning) might degrade cost but reduce error rate; need PM decision.

product_lead: Decision: implement the matrix. Create a shared spreadsheet (`/product/postlaunch/mini_lanes`) with columns: ticket, severity, customer, infra_cost_delta, owner, eta, canary_plan. Maria + Samir own initial triage. Ajay to estimate infra. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 to finalize owners.

ops_bot: Reminder: deploying hotfix requires runbook signoff. Use `#eng-oncall` for deploy approvals.

maria_g: posted initial triage (link) — flagged 6 immediate hotfix candidates and 12 enhancement backlog items.

samir_p: Great. Next steps: 1) owners assigned by tomorrow EOD, 2) hotfix lane starts Monday, 3) enhancements get grooming tickets for March milestone. If anyone thinks we need a separate rollout policy (canary % / rollback triggers), call it out now.

ajay_k: I'll draft canary thresholds: 1% traffic for 2h then 5% for 6h if stable, automated rollback if error_rate increases by >50% or p99 regresses >30%.

product_lead: Perfect. Thanks team — we'll run this plan and review after first hotfix cycle. :thumbsup:
